finding.title: Buffer Overflow
finding.trigger: If the input 'id' is exactly 2 characters long, the strncpy will copy 2 characters, and the explicit null termination will overwrite the last character of the _id array, leading to a buffer overflow.
finding.assumptions: The input 'id' is expected to be exactly 2 characters long, but the code does not enforce this. The _id array is declared with a size of 3, which includes the null terminator.

parsed.refutation_attempt: Checked the bounds of the _id array (size 3) and the strncpy call. The call uses sizeof(_id)-1 which equals 2, so at most 2 characters are copied into indices 0 and 1. The subsequent explicit null termination writes to index 2, which is the third element and within bounds. No path exists that writes beyond the array. No other checks or conditions affect this logic.
